recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Any future executable successor/predecessor resolve() constraints should go back to Vocabulary/FHIR-I review because the Jira application explicitly records that those constraints were deliberately omitted.
issue_request: FHIR-50011 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked Vocabulary to apply the RelatedArtifact guidance from FHIR-50010 to CodeSystem, ConceptMap, NamingSystem, and ValueSet by prohibiting depends-on and composed-of relatedArtifact types and by constraining successor/predecessor targets to the same terminology resource kind.
initial_application: Source commit 50b0f2cf34b6642c1e9ea57b827d69eb3647331d added the depends-on/composed-of invariants and successor/predecessor explanatory text to all four terminology StructureDefinitions. The Jira follow-up comment records that resolve() constraints were intentionally not added after PR review discussion. The implementation left the new CodeSystem, ConceptMap, and NamingSystem invariant source canonicals pointing at ValueSet.
additional_context: FHIR-50010 is the broader Applied/Persuasive RelatedArtifact datatype and guidance issue. A Zulip implementer thread records the rationale for resource-specific RelatedArtifact restrictions and names FHIR-50011 as the terminology follow-up. The 2025-04-10 Vocabulary minutes approved the FHIR-50011 disposition 6-0-0. The affected StructureDefinition XML files are active current-build resource sources under source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit that preserves the applied FHIR-50011 constraints and the decision not to add resolve() invariants, while correcting csd-8 to source CodeSystem, cmd-14 to source ConceptMap, and nsd-4 to source NamingSystem.
source_changes: source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml: changed the csd-8 constraint source canonical from ValueSet to CodeSystem.
source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml: changed the cmd-14 constraint source canonical from ValueSet to ConceptMap.
source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml: changed the nsd-4 constraint source canonical from ValueSet to NamingSystem.
